text:
Jules (AE): Heads up team — we just got an RFP from Orpheus Health. They want a filled capability matrix, security questionnaire answers, a short POC runbook, and a clear pricing appendix showing reserved vs burst examples. Deadline = 3 business days. I uploaded the draft matrix: https://redwood.app/files/orpheus_matrix_draft.xlsx

Sam P. - Solutions Eng: Quick read — primary technical asks: 1) sustain ~5k embeddings qps (they call it peak), 2) BYOK / HSM key-wrap for on-prem connectors, 3) ability to pin model versions during the POC.

Ivy (Infra): From infra POV — 5k qps is achievable but depends on model footprint and batching. Two options: Dedicated reserve (we can propose a commitment with SLA) or Hosted with autoscale + fallback. Suggested config for dedicated POC:
```
model: redwood-embed-v3
nodes: 6 x A100-80
batching: dynamic (batch_max=512)
cache: kv-prefix enabled
network: private peering + 10Gb egress reservation
```
If they want Private deployment (their VPC), HSM validation/testing adds ~48-72 hours for integration checks.

Nina (Security): Reviewed questionnaire. Top items to address in our submission:
- KMS/HSM: we support customer-managed keys via cross-account KMS and can do key wrapping with an HSM gateway. For on-prem HSM we need an architecture review + attestation steps.
- Logging & retention: provide defaults and note where custom retention is chargeable.
- Incident response SLA: we can offer <1hr notification for enterprise contracts but Legal needs to sign the clause.
I'll attach SOC2 and the KMS integration doc.

Sam P. - Solutions Eng: I'll populate capability matrix with measured qps for two model variants (fp16 and 8-bit quantized), and include a POC ops checklist: bench command, success KPIs, monitoring hooks, and fallback plan. Example bench: `ri bench --model redwood-embed-v3 --concurrency 120 --batch-max 512 --duration 600`

Jules (AE): Can you also add two short pricing examples for the appendix (1hr test, 8hr day, 24hr run) showing reserved vs hosted-burst? They asked for a line-item for HSM add-on.

Ivy (Infra): I'll draft the network/peering steps and a short config snippet for their infra team (peering CIDR, firewall ports, expected egress). Also note that reserved pool SLA for POC can be scoped to the reserved hours only.

Nina (Security): Uploading attachments now: SOC2: https://redwood.app/security/soc2_2025.pdf; KMS guide: https://redwood.app/docs/kms-hsm-guide. Flagging the HSM attestation item to Legal — may require an addendum.

ci-bot: POC sandbox environment creation started: ci-job/orpheus-poc-sbox queued (eta 1768892000).

Sam P. - Solutions Eng: Action list created:
- Fill capability matrix with qps numbers + model options (due tomorrow EOD)
- POC ops checklist + bench artifacts (due tomorrow EOD)

Ivy (Infra): Action list:
- Network peering checklist + HSM integration notes (due tomorrow EOD)

Nina (Security): Action list:
- Complete questionnaire answers + attach reports (due in 2 business days).

Jules (AE): I'll compile all artifacts and draft the response to procurement once we have drafts. Will also include a short slide summarizing tradeoffs (cost vs SLA vs accuracy). If Legal asks for the attestation language, ping me.

Sam P. - Solutions Eng: Noted. I'll include a canary fallback plan (lower-capacity model) + traffic shaping guidance. :thumbsup:

Jules (AE): Thanks — keep updates here. If anyone needs to call procurement contact (Marta), I have her email.

Nina (Security): One more note — they asked about audit logs being sent to their SIEM. We can stream logs to customer S3 or to their syslog endpoint; add that option to the matrix.

Ivy (Infra): Adding that to infra checklist.

ci-bot: Sandbox deployed at 1768891987. Logs available: https://redwood.app/ci/orpheus-sbox/logs

Jules (AE): Perfect. Closing actions for now.
